clues: This city region sits in the middle of a small land in the west of Europe. It grew up by a small river, and now it is the heart of that land.
Sea air from the Atlantic keeps this place mild, since the coast is not far off. Rain falls on about 135 days a year, and snow is rare.
In 1989 this city region was made a land of two tongues by law. Both French and Dutch are its state tongues, though French is heard most.
This city is hailed as a world home of the comic strip. Its love of Belgian comics goes back a long way, and fans know it well.
Its grand old main square and the Atomium are its top sights. Guests from all round the world come to see them each year.
